name: 5414-singlestream-70b-4gpu
parallelism: TP=4, PP=1, DP=1, one node, one in-process engine.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=1, bounded at 60 requests OR 240 s of benchmark wall-clock, whichever fires first, first 5% warmup by completion.
workload: guidellm synthetic_text, single turn, no prefix_buckets, request_format plain (raw prompt, no chat template — this engine era cannot do the templated path); prompt exactly 512 tokens, output exactly 256 with ignore_eos.
purpose: A single-user chat assistant on a 70-billion-parameter model, streaming 256-token replies from 512-token prompts across four GPUs.
launch:
# Engine command line for item 5414-singlestream-70b-4gpu, at commit
# f23871e9eead900d6146961ca894f5bc91f30f5e (v0.5.0.post1-107-gf23871e9eead9).
# use-v2-block-manager is REQUIRED, not a choice: this engine refuses to start under
# speculative decoding without it.

model: NousResearch/Llama-2-70b-chat-hf
speculative-model: TinyLlama/TinyLlama-1.1B-Chat-v1.0
num-speculative-tokens: 5
tensor-parallel-size: 4
dtype: float16
use-v2-block-manager: true
gpu-memory-utilization: 0.90
enable-prefix-caching: false
